create_llff_dataset: create an LLFFDataset instance to load and iterate over LLFF-format forward-facing scene images and camera poses
convert_rays_to_ndc: convert a set of ray origins and directions to NDC coordinates using the convert_to_ndc function
build_camera_intrinsics: build a camera intrinsics dictionary with width, height, fx, fy, px, py using the buildCamera function
build_nerf_poses: build a dictionary of camera poses from a NeRF pose array using the buildNerfPoses function
load_colmap_binary: load COLMAP sparse reconstruction images and cameras from binary files using readImagesBinary and readCamerasBinary
